definitions.explanation: A baby or young pig. Used both in farming contexts and in stories, fairy tales, and as a term of endearment.

examples.japanese: {子豚|こぶた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{子豚|こぶた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can touch piglets at the farm.

examples.japanese: {三匹|さんびき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子豚|こぶた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親|した}しまれている→親しむ：14139_shitashimu⟧。
examples.english: The story of the three little pigs is beloved by children around the world.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (child; young) and ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧ (pig), with rendaku changing ぶた to ぶた (the initial consonant does not change here since it is already voiced). Commonly encountered in the fairy tale {三匹|さんびき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子豚|こぶた} (The Three Little Pigs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子豚|こぶた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧: a piglet is born
- {三匹|さんびき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子豚|こぶた}: The Three Little Pigs
- {子豚|こぶた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise piglets
